messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate observed for /v1/generate in region eu-west-1 (rate 8.2% > threshold 1%). Routing policy: canary-v2 -> fallback sticky -> stable-v1. Incident ID: INC-2468013579 :rotating_light:
oncall-sre: Acked. jumping in. seeing 502s and some provably bad outputs (nonsense).
sana-k: noticed rollout for canary-v2 started ~ 2468012200. Canary traffic 10% -> many requests are being routed to fallback which binds to variant 'stable-q8' in eu-west-1. Could be wrong variant tag binding.
mike-l: @sana-k can you confirm if stable-q8 was intended as fallback? It shouldn't be serving chat-gen workloads.
sana-k: It was supposed to be stable-fp16, not q8. Looks like policy mismatch on variant selector. maybe config drift during model onboarding.
jordan-eng: logs show a mapping mismatch in policy store: `policy.canary_v2.fallback_variant: stable-q8` — that key was changed in config push earlier today (2468011500) by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: auto-deploy: config/policies/routing.yml applied by ci-cd (pipeline #1142).
oncall-ml: Hey, customer reports include hallucinations and truncated responses — consistent with feeding a quantized-only variant that wasn't validated for that model architecture.
eva-cs: Customer ticket #C-11342 reports latency spikes and a few bad outputs; they've paused user-facing experiments but customers see production impact. ETA for next update?
oncall-sre: First mitigation: pause the canary rollout. Command: `routectl rollout pause canary-v2` — doing now.
ops: I'm setting a temporary override to route all canary traffic back to stable-fp16 in eu-west-1: `routectl override set canary-v2 fallback_variant=stable-fp16 region=eu-west-1 ttl=5m`
mike-l: Hold on before TTL expires, we need to ensure sticky sessions unbind. Current sticky affinity is binding sessions that hit fallback to the quantized variant for 1h. That's causing repeat bad responses.
oncall-ml: Can we force unbind sticky affinity for active sessions?
jordan-eng: There's an API: `routingctl unbind-affinity --selector canary-v2 --region eu-west-1 --force`. Running it now.
[code block]
$ routingctl unbind-affinity --selector canary-v2 --region eu-west-1 --force
Response: 1200 sessions unbound, 47 inflight requests allowed to finish.
[/code block]
oncall-sre: Good. Now roll back the erroneous policy change in config store. Reverting to previous commit.
deploy-bot: revert triggered: config/policies/routing.yml reverts to commit 8e3a2f. Applying...
deploy-bot: applied successfully. New effective fallback_variant=stable-fp16 for canary-v2 in eu-west-1.
sana-k: Confirming fallback mapping corrected. Will monitor for regression.
eva-cs: Notifying impacted customers: posting in support system and flagging for SRE/CS follow-up.
support-bot: Ticket C-11342 updated: "Mitigation applied — routing correction and sticky affinity cleared. Monitoring for 30m. Status: in progress."
oncall-ml: Observability: perf graphs show errors dropping back to 0.9% within ~6 minutes of override. Latency back to baseline.
oncall-sre: Paging to oncall-ml and eng to validate outputs. Can people run quick evals against canary-v2?
mike-l: Running eval runset A (smoke). A few failures persisted for requests that were inflight while we unbound affinity. Out of 2000 samples, 12 malformed outputs — mainly truncated text. Acceptable for now but need root cause.
jordan-eng: Root cause hypothesis: config push pipeline allowed fallback_variant values that are not validated against model capability tags (quantized vs fp). We'll add a CI gate to verify compatibility.
sana-k: I'll open a follow-up ticket to add validation: TASK-2468014. Assigning to eng-platform and eng-ml.
ops: Also, add an automated rollback action if canary error rate > 1% for 5m after rollout start.
oncall-sre: Agreed. For immediate remediation: rollout paused, fallback corrected, sticky affinity unbound, customers notified. Putting incident to 'mitigated' but keep monitoring for 1h.
eva-cs: Thanks — I'll coordinate post-incident comms and ask legal if any sensitive customer logs need special handling.
mike-l: quick note: we should add a non-prod gate to run the actual quantized variant in a shadow traffic mode before allowing it as fallback.
oncall-ml: accepted. Adding to postmortem.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-2468013579 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity: Sev2. Assigned: eng-platform, eng-ml, eng-sre. Postmortem due in 72h.
oncall-sre: handing off to next on-call in 30 minutes @oncall-sre (tomorrow). If anything spikes, page the escalation channel.
sana-k: thanks all. will draft timeline and put preliminary notes in #postmortems/2468013579. :memo:
support-bot: Ticket C-11342 marked awaiting customer confirmation.
ops: leaving a retention note: snapshotting policy store and routing logs to gs://redwood-incidents/2468013579/ for postmortem.
jordan-eng: quick command used for debugging (for the postmortem):
```
# show policy mapping
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://config.redwood.internal/policies/canary-v2 | jq .fallback_variant
```

oncall-ml: Last check: errors steady <0.8% for 20m. Closing pager.
incident-bot: Pager closed by oncall-sre at 2468014399.
